gloss: person entrusted with a task; mandatary

definitions.gloss: person entrusted with a task; mandatary
definitions.explanation: In law, the party who accepts a commission to handle a matter on behalf of another; the one who is entrusted, as opposed to the one who entrusts.

examples.japanese: {受任者|じゅにんしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}ぶ→契約を結ぶ：18695_keiyakuwomusubu⟧。
examples.english: Enter into a contract as the entrusted party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{受任者|じゅにんしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: A lawyer acts as the mandatary and carries out the procedures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{委任|いにん}→委任：23054_inin⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{受任者|じゅにんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{依頼人|いらいにん}→依頼人：18953_irainin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誠実|せいじつ}→誠実：14211_seijitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Under a mandate contract, the entrusted party must act faithfully in the client's interest.

notes:
Composed of {受任|じゅにん} (accepting a commission) + the suffix ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). A legal term used mainly in connection with mandate (⟦{委任|いにん}→委任：23054_inin⟧) contracts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受任者|じゅにんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧: the duties of the entrusted party
- {受任者|じゅにんしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become the mandatary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{委任者|いにんしゃ}→委任者：29303_ininsha⟧: the entrusting party — the counterpart who grants the commission
- ⟦{代理人|だいりにん}→代理人：18508_dairinin⟧: agent; proxy — one authorized to act on another's behalf, often overlapping in practice
